title: Quietly Crunchy Mediterranean Eggplant Skewers
description: Sweet and crunchy Mediterranean dish featuring tamarind paste and dum, perfect for a romantic lacto-vegetarian dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the eggplant cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together the tamarind paste, dum, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the tamarind mixture onto the eggplant cubes, making sure they are fully coated.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and top each with a sprinkle of feta cheese and a sprinkle of parsley.
Return the skewers to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the eggplant is tender.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
